create_distilbert_model: create a DistilBertModel instance for extracting contextual embeddings from input text sequences
build_masked_lm: build a DistilBertForMaskedLM model to predict masked tokens in a sequence using cross-entropy loss
run_sequence_classifier: run a DistilBertForSequenceClassification model for GLUE tasks with configurable num_labels and problem_type
test_question_answering: test a DistilBertForQuestionAnswering model that outputs start and end logits for span extraction
review_token_classifier: review a DistilBertForTokenClassification model for token-level labeling such as NER with configurable num_labels
